summary: Visual discovery platform with APIs for pins, boards and ads.
access_note: Apps need Pinterest review for Trial access before API use; Standard access requires a further application.
blocker_note: Pinterest reviews apps for Trial access, and Standard access is needed for production use by other users.

evidence.quote: Our implementation of grant types and access tokens follows OAuth 2.0 specifications.
Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest.
Pinterest API services are only available to authenticated and authorized users.
Be the first to know when it launches.
